# nanoDNS UI CJK subsets

Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).
Noto is a trademark of Google Inc.

These eight modified fonts derive from Noto Sans CJK version 2.004,
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk, commit `f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c`.
They remain licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt.
The original copyright, trademark, and license records are retained in
each font, including the complete OFL text. Modified family names are
nanoDNS UI SC, TC, JP, and KR. The full upstream fonts are not shipped.

Regional Regular and Light fonts are restricted to each GUI catalog,
printable ASCII, and the punctuation listed by subset-cjk-fonts.py.
UPSTREAM-NOTICE.md is preserved verbatim from the pinned repository.
